sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-32B is Alibaba's 32-billion-parameter base checkpoint from the Qwen2.5 series, released in September 2024. It is a dense transformer pretrained on a multilingual corpus, serves as the foundation for instruction-tuned and specialized Qwen2.5 variants, and is released under Apache 2.0.
